/**
 * Custom esbuild bundler for the Cloudflare Worker.
 *
 * Wrangler's built-in esbuild cannot mark specific packages as external, so we
 * pre-bundle the worker here and point wrangler to the output with --no-bundle.
 *
 * Approach:
 *   - platform: "neutral" so esbuild doesn't inject browser/node polyfills
 *   - node:* builtins are external — provided at runtime by CF nodejs_compat
 *   - cloudflare:* modules are external — provided by the CF runtime
 *   - embedded-postgres / @embedded-postgres/* — native Node binaries, not available
 *     in Workers; no CF code path reaches these
 *   - jsdom — Node-only; SVG sanitization path (assets.ts) will throw at runtime in CF
 *   - node:sqlite — pulled in by undici@7 via jsdom; not available in Workers
 */

import { build } from "esbuild";
import { fileURLToPath } from "url";
import path from "path";

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

// Node.js built-ins that CF provides via nodejs_compat flag
const NODE_BUILTINS = [
  "node:assert", "node:async_hooks", "node:buffer", "node:child_process",
  "node:cluster", "node:console", "node:constants", "node:crypto",
  "node:dgram", "node:diagnostics_channel", "node:dns", "node:domain",
  "node:events", "node:fs", "node:fs/promises", "node:http", "node:http2",
  "node:https", "node:inspector", "node:module", "node:net", "node:os",
  "node:path", "node:perf_hooks", "node:process", "node:querystring",
  "node:readline", "node:repl", "node:stream", "node:stream/consumers",
  "node:stream/promises", "node:stream/web", "node:string_decoder",
  "node:sys", "node:timers", "node:timers/promises", "node:tls",
  "node:trace_events", "node:tty", "node:url", "node:util", "node:util/types",
  "node:v8", "node:vm", "node:wasi", "node:worker_threads", "node:zlib",
  // Without "node:" prefix (legacy imports)
  "assert", "async_hooks", "buffer", "child_process", "cluster", "console",
  "constants", "crypto", "dgram", "diagnostics_channel", "dns", "domain",
  "events", "fs", "http", "http2", "https", "inspector", "module", "net",
  "os", "path", "perf_hooks", "process", "querystring", "readline", "repl",
  "stream", "string_decoder", "sys", "timers", "tls", "trace_events", "tty",
  "url", "util", "v8", "vm", "wasi", "worker_threads", "zlib",
  // Node 22.5+ built-in pulled in by undici@7 — not available in Workers
  "node:sqlite",
];

await build({
  entryPoints: [path.join(__dirname, "src/worker/api.ts")],
  bundle: true,
  outfile: path.join(__dirname, "dist/worker.js"),
  format: "esm",
  target: "es2022",
  platform: "neutral",
  conditions: ["workerd", "worker", "browser", "module"],
  mainFields: ["module", "main"],
  external: [
    // CF runtime modules
    "cloudflare:*",
    // Node built-ins (provided by nodejs_compat)
    ...NODE_BUILTINS,
    // Node-only packages not available in CF Workers
    "embedded-postgres",
    "@embedded-postgres/*",
    "jsdom",
  ],
  splitting: false,
  define: {
    "process.env.NODE_ENV": '"production"',
  },
  logLevel: "info",
});

console.log("Worker bundle written to dist/worker.js");
